conceptual_change: Introduce a 1-hour candle close confirmation constraint to the SMA crossover signal logic, requiring that the price at the close of the signal candle must strictly exceed (for long) or be strictly below (for short) the long-term trend indicator value, as defined in research/BTCUSDT_1h_hypotheses_v1.json.
rationale: The previous implementation failed due to missing architectural support; this hypothesis focuses on the logic constraint requirement derived from the baseline research trend parameters, assuming the engine integration task is handled as a prerequisite.
